title: CodeChallenge: HellaSwag evals in two models (part 2)

cues.en: And now to continue with the code challenge that we began in the previous video.

cues.zh: 也就是一段語境、四個結尾，其中一個正確。

cues.en: You can copy the code from two videos ago.
cues.zh: 可以複製兩支影片前的程式。

cues.en: Make sure that your Python code takes as input one hella swag sample a model and a tokenizer.

cues.zh: 要能傳入模型與 tokenizer，因為會用同一函數評估兩模型，而它們各有 tokenizer。

cues.en: And the function that you write here should output the accuracy of that sample.
cues.zh: 函數應輸出該樣本的準確結果。

cues.zh: 也就是這個例子。

cues.zh: 判斷正確結尾的 log_softmax logits 加總是否最高。

cues.en: The two key take home points from this code challenge are first that there is an increasing diversity of model architectures.
cues.zh: 挑戰有兩個重點。第一，模型架構越來越多樣。

cues.en: The transformer block and the embeddings vectors is quite fundamental and universal.
cues.zh: Transformer 區塊與嵌入向量，是相當基本、普遍的組件。

cues.en: So all successful language models have those two features, but there are many clever people who are coming up with clever modifications to those architectures.
cues.zh: 成功的語言模型都有這兩點，但也有許多聰明人，設計巧妙的架構修改。

cues.en: Some of those modifications are designed to make the models better at certain tasks.
cues.zh: 有些為了在特定任務表現更好，

cues.en: Some modifications are designed to make the models better in general, and some modifications are designed
cues.zh: 有些為了整體更好，有些則為了

cues.en: to make the models be as small and lightweight as possible without sacrificing too much performance.
cues.zh: 在不犧牲太多表現下，盡量縮小、輕量化。

cues.en: The second point is just a reiteration of the central theme of this and the next sections, which is that none of the benchmark or evaluation methods is perfect.
cues.zh: 第二，重申這一章與下一章的核心主題：沒有完美的基準或評估方法。

cues.en: You should never rely on just one method.
cues.zh: 永遠不要只依賴一種。

cues.en: In the next few videos, I'll introduce you to another way of approaching evaluations, which is to
cues.zh: 接下來幾支會介紹另一種評估方式，

cues.en: focus not on individual tokens and not on sentences, but on distributions over larger pieces of text.
cues.zh: 不只看個別詞元或句子，而是更長文本的分布。
